READING THE EVIDENCE

Solver resultA reported answer; reconstruction is not implied.

ReconstructedA proof was produced; independent checking is not implied.

Kernel checkedExplicitly reported kernel verification.

No checked proofThe report records failure or no proof assurance.

UnspecifiedThe report does not declare its trust category.
